name: Nani Kamala
look: a cheerful South Indian grandmother in her late sixties, silver hair in a neat bun, round gold-rimmed glasses, small bindi, wearing a bright cotton saree in teal and mustard with a cardigan, warm brown skin, big kind smile
personality: cheeky and adventurous; drives her little red convertible a bit too proudly, loves stargazing, never loses an argument, says 'Shall we find out?'

name: Abuela Rosa
look: a lively Mexican grandmother in her late sixties, short curly salt-and-pepper hair, red-framed glasses, light-brown skin, wearing denim overalls over a flowered blouse, a tool belt or apron depending on the scene
personality: a mischievous tinkerer who fixes bikes, builds gadgets and plays harmless pranks on her friends, says 'Let's build it!'

name: Grandma Mae
look: a joyful African American grandmother in her early seventies, short natural grey curls, dark brown skin, pearl earrings, wearing a sunny yellow cardigan over a patterned dress, a garden hat outdoors
personality: a sassy baker and gardener with a big laugh who secretly sneaks extra cookies, says 'Well, isn't that something!'

name: Halmoni Soon-ja
look: an energetic Korean grandmother in her late sixties, short permed grey hair, light skin, wearing a lavender fleece jacket, hiking pants and a sun visor, binoculars around her neck when outdoors
personality: a fearless, competitive hiker and camper who out-walks teenagers and protects every creature she meets, says 'Look closely!'

name: Nonna Lucia
look: a warm Italian grandmother in her early seventies, wavy white hair to her shoulders, olive skin, green eyes, wearing a cozy olive-green knit sweater and a silver necklace, an apron when cooking
personality: a dramatic, playful music lover who dances anywhere, spoils animals and scolds litterbugs, says 'Che bello!'

name: Obaachan Haruko
look: a graceful Japanese grandmother in her seventies, short silver bob, small round glasses, light skin, wearing a soft indigo cardigan over a simple blouse
personality: calm, precise and quietly funny, loves tea, gardens and morning walks

name: Mama Ngozi
look: a radiant Nigerian grandmother in her seventies, short grey natural hair under a colourful gele headwrap, dark brown skin, wearing a bright patterned ankara dress
personality: loud laugh, generous cook, loves market days and dancing

name: Teta Leila
look: a warm Lebanese grandmother in her seventies, wavy grey hair in a low bun, olive skin, gold hoop earrings, wearing a soft burgundy cardigan
personality: hospitable and witty, feeds everyone, loves herbs and olive trees

name: Lola Remedios
look: a cheerful Filipino grandmother in her seventies, short grey curly hair, warm tan skin, wearing a floral blouse and a pearl necklace
personality: sweet and teasing, loves karaoke, rice dishes and her garden

name: Nai Nai Mei
look: a lively Chinese grandmother in her seventies, short grey permed hair, light skin, wearing a jade-green quilted jacket
personality: energetic and wise, practises tai chi in the park, loves soups and dumplings

name: Babushka Olga
look: a sturdy Russian grandmother in her seventies, grey hair under a floral headscarf, fair skin, rosy cheeks, wearing a knitted cardigan
personality: stern-looking but soft-hearted, loves pickling, soup and long walks

name: Vovó Ana
look: a joyful Brazilian grandmother in her seventies, curly grey hair, warm brown skin, wearing a bright yellow blouse and colourful bead bracelets
personality: sunny and musical, loves samba, fruit and the beach

name: Mama Wanjiru
look: a strong Kenyan grandmother in her seventies, short grey hair, dark skin, wearing a patterned kanga wrap and beaded earrings
personality: hardworking farmer and storyteller, loves tea and long walks

name: Abuelita Saya
look: a kind Andean Peruvian grandmother in her seventies, long grey braids, warm brown skin, wearing a colourful woven shawl and a bowler-style hat
personality: patient weaver and cook, loves potatoes, quinoa and mountain air

name: Nokomis June
look: a gentle Ojibwe grandmother in her seventies, long grey hair in a single braid, warm brown skin, wearing a denim jacket and beaded earrings
personality: calm and wise, loves wild rice, berry picking and the lakeshore
